label: Liquid Fill
author: Conky-Studio
description: Rounded vessel with animated wavy liquid surface. Fill level follows Value (min→max).
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h, rad = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}, {corner_radius}
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local pct = ((tonumber({value}) or min_v) - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local lr, lg, lb = {color}
 -- vessel
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity} * 0.75)
 if rad > 0 then
  local r = math.min(rad, w/2, h/2)
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+w-r, y+r, r, -math.pi/2, 0)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+w-r, y+h-r, r, 0, math.pi/2)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+r, y+h-r, r, math.pi/2, math.pi)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+r, y+r, r, math.pi, 3*math.pi/2)
  cairo_close_path(cr)
 else
  cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y, w, h)
 end
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- liquid with wave surface
 local level_y = y + h * (1 - pct)
 local amp = {wave_amp}
 local t = wall_clock() * {wave_speed}
 cairo_save(cr)
 -- clip to vessel
 if rad > 0 then
  local r = math.min(rad, w/2, h/2)
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+w-r, y+r, r, -math.pi/2, 0)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+w-r, y+h-r, r, 0, math.pi/2)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+r, y+h-r, r, math.pi/2, math.pi)
  cairo_arc(cr, x+r, y+r, r, math.pi, 3*math.pi/2)
  cairo_close_path(cr)
 else
  cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y, w, h)
 end
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, lr, lg, lb, {opacity} * 0.9)
 cairo_new_path(cr)
 local steps = math.max(12, math.floor(w / 4))
 for i = 0, steps do
  local u = i / steps
  local px = x + u * w
  local py = level_y + math.sin(u * 4 * math.pi + t) * amp + math.sin(u * 7 * math.pi - t * 1.3) * (amp * 0.4)
  if i == 0 then cairo_move_to(cr, px, py) else cairo_line_to(cr, px, py) end
 end
 cairo_line_to(cr, x + w, y + h)
 cairo_line_to(cr, x, y + h)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_restore(cr)
